_comment: Known LaTeX/Quarto divergences, tracked under #3499. The check fails only on divergences NOT listed here. Shrink this file as the trees are reconciled; never grow it to silence a new one. Held at four coverage entries as of 2026-08-01, after removing eight superseded-value entries whose values were each verified to be absent from the file named. A stale entry is not idle: it grants standing permission for that exact defect to reappear unnoticed, which is the opposite of what this file is for. Two notes on what remains. 'ch32_putting' is a 40-line stub that main.tex does not \include either, so it is absent from both editions and the phrase 'website readers cannot reach this chapter' understates it -- no reader can; it is listed because the checker compares directory contents rather than the book's include list. The two 'glossary' entries are the opposite case: each LaTeX volume carries its own glossary while the Quarto tree has one shared glossary.qmd, so they are a structural choice, not missing content.
